STEP 1 - Scene: mixed plated meal, Caesar-style salad, roasted Brussels sprouts, roasted zucchini/summer squash, rice/grain dish with chicken or tofu, overhead view.

STEP 2 - Vessel: square white plate, ~26 cm side, treat as dinner plate 26 cm diameter.
Area: 3.14 x (13)^2 = 531 cm^2

STEP 3 - Items:
- Caesar-style salad with dressing, shaved parmesan
- Roasted Brussels sprouts
- Roasted zucchini / yellow squash
- Rice/grain dish (brown rice, sauced)
- Chicken or tofu pieces

STEP 4 - Area:
- Caesar salad 25% = 133 cm^2
- Brussels sprouts 15% = 80 cm^2
- Zucchini/squash 8% = 42 cm^2
- Rice dish 20% = 106 cm^2
- Chicken/tofu pieces 7% = 37 cm^2
- Total covered 75% (~398 cm^2)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Caesar salad 133 cm^2 x 3 cm = 399 ml
- Brussels sprouts 80 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 200 ml
- Zucchini 42 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 63 ml
- Rice dish 106 cm^2 x 2 cm = 212 ml
- Chicken/tofu 37 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 56 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Salad 399 ml x 0.15 = 60 g
- Brussels sprouts 200 ml x 0.6 = 120 g
- Zucchini 63 ml x 0.6 = 38 g
- Rice dish 212 ml x 0.8 = 170 g
- Chicken/tofu 56 ml x 0.95 = 53 g
- Total 441 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Salad (dressing, parmesan) 60 g x 150 kcal/100g = 90 kcal
- Brussels sprouts 120 g x 43 = 52 kcal
- Zucchini 38 g x 17 = 6 kcal
- Rice dish (oil, sauce) 170 g x 150 = 255 kcal
- Chicken/tofu 53 g x 165 = 87 kcal
- Total 490 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: 441 g and 490 kcal fit a three-quarter-covered dinner plate with a Caesar salad, roasted vegetables, and a rice dish.
